newsitem.title: USA: No damaging freeze expected for Brazil coffee - WSC.
newsitem.headline: No damaging freeze expected for Brazil coffee - WSC.

text.p: Low pressure currently forming off the southeast coast of Brazil will bring colder air into the coffee belt over the weekend, however the airmass should not be cold enough to produce a damaging freeze, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Friday.
Widespread showers and thunderstorms were reported this morning throughout the region. Low temperatures ranged from the upper 50's to low 60's (middle teens C).
According to WSC, the unusually heavy rains of the past 24-48 hours will imporve soil moisture conditions for the trees entering the dry winter season.
Skies are expected to clear today. Fair to partly cloudy skies will arrive on Saturday and should stay through Monday. Temperatures may cool to well below normal ranging from 37-45 F (3-7 C).
The extended outlook calls for fair to partly cloudy skies and slowly moderating temperatures next week.
